name: Mestare
description: Mestare was a planet where unique lightsaber crystals were mined. It was said that lightsabers which utilized these crystals could cut through cortosis, a lightsaber-resistant metal. The unique crystals were also known to make the lightsaber blades curved, similar to ancient Jedi katanas. Mestare Jedi also wore protective armor for an unknown reason.
